page.title: Privacy policy
page.lead: What the site keeps about you, why, where and for how long, and your rights. This page describes what the site actually does.

summary.title: In short
summary.minimum: We keep only what is needed to play and to protect the players.
summary.noTracking: No ads, no analytics, no tracking: only the cookies the site needs to work, so there is no cookie banner.
summary.chat: The chat is kept only while its room exists, unless someone reports a player.
summary.delete: You can delete your account yourself, from your profile.
summary.age: The site is for people aged 15 and over.

data.title: What we keep, and why

guest.title: If you play as a guest
guest.text: The name you choose and a random id are stored in a signed cookie in your browser (sh_guest), valid for 30 days. There is no account. Other players see your name in the rooms you enter, and it appears in the results of the games you play (see "Games").

account.title: If you create an account
account.email: your e-mail address, to sign you in. It is shown neither to other players nor to moderators;
account.password: your password, only in a scrambled form that cannot be reversed (bcrypt);
account.name: your player name, the only name others see, and the date you last changed it;
account.age: the date you confirmed being 15 or older;
account.other: your language, your role on the site (player, moderator or admin), whether your e-mail address is verified, and when the account was created and last changed.
account.google: If you sign in with Google (when the site offers it), we keep only your Google account id, to recognise you next time. We keep neither your Google name, nor your picture, nor the sign-in tokens Google sends us.

games.title: Games
games.text: When a game ends, private or public, its room sends the result to the site: the room code, start and end times, the outcome and, for each seat, the name shown, the role, whether the player was alive, whether they won and whether the site was playing for them at the end. Guests' names are included too.
games.log: We also keep how the game went (the initial draw and every action with its time, identified by seat number, not by name) so it can be replayed later. Your history is shown on your profile.

blocks.title: Blocks and muted players
blocks.text: If you block a player, we keep that block until you remove it: it hides their messages and keeps you apart in quick match. Muting a player only concerns your browser: the list is kept in its local storage for 7 days, and the site never knows.

chat.title: Rooms and the chat
chat.text: While a room exists, its server keeps the list of people in it (name, account or guest id, and your blocks to filter the chat), the game in progress and the latest 300 chat messages. None of this is in our database. It is all deleted with the room: 30 minutes after the game ends (a rematch keeps the same room), or once a waiting room has been empty for 30 minutes. If the room cannot deliver a game's result to the site, it keeps trying for up to 3 days before it is deleted.
chat.lobby: For quick match, the list of open public rooms also keeps the accounts in each one, until the room closes.

reports.title: Reports and moderation
reports.text: When someone reports a player, the room sends the moderators who reported whom, the reason, any comment, and a copy of what it holds at that moment: the latest 100 chat messages, the game's public log and the list of people present (name, account or guest id, seat, host or not, connected or not). This is the only time chat is stored in our database.
reports.actions: We also keep suspensions (reason and dates) and a record of every moderation decision: suspension, lifting it, renaming, dismissing a report, moderators' notes.

visits.title: Rooms visited
visits.text: So that a suspension also closes live connections, we note the codes of the rooms your account entered, with the date of the last entry.

security.title: Protection against abuse
security.text: To slow down abuse, we count some actions (sign-in attempts, sign-ups, guest names, room creation, reports, quick matches…) per IP address, per e-mail address or per account. We store neither the IP address nor the e-mail address: only a fingerprint (computed with a secret key), a counter and a date. A few short-lived counters exist only in the server's memory.

technical.title: Technical data at our hosts
technical.text: To serve the pages and run the games, our hosts process your IP address and technical details of your requests, and keep logs of them under their own rules.

mail.title: E-mails
mail.text: The site does not send any e-mail for now.

data.sharing: Your data is not sold or used for advertising. It is entrusted only to our hosts, to run the site.

bases.title: On what grounds
bases.service: Running the service you ask for: your account or guest name, games, history, blocks.
bases.safety: Keeping the site and its players safe: reports, moderation, suspensions, abuse counters, rooms visited. This is our legitimate interest, and it lets us act on reports of illegal content.
bases.consent: As the site uses only necessary cookies, it does not ask for your consent.

hosting.title: Where your data is
hosting.vercel: Website: Vercel. Pages go through its worldwide network; the server code runs in Paris (region cdg1).
hosting.neon: Database: Neon (part of Databricks), in Frankfurt (region fra1).
hosting.cloudflare: Game server: Cloudflare. We ask for each room to be created in a data centre in Western Europe; Cloudflare usually follows this, but does not guarantee it.
hosting.us: All three providers are US companies. Their own terms explain how they handle data transfers outside the European Union. Their addresses are in the <link>legal notice</link>.

retention.title: For how long
retention.lead: Where the site does not set a limit yet, we say so.
retention.caption: How long each kind of data is kept

games.what: Game results and how each game went
games.howLong: No time limit for now. If you delete your account, your name and the link to your account are erased: you appear as "Deleted player".

chat.what: A room: people present, the game and its chat
chat.howLong: The room's life: deleted 30 minutes after the game ends (up to 3 days if the result could not be delivered)

reports.what: Reports and their copy (chat, log, people present)
reports.howLong: No time limit for now, even after the accounts involved are deleted (the names at the time stay)

moderation.howLong: No time limit for now; after an account is deleted, its name at the time stays

bans.howLong: Until the suspended account is deleted

blocks.howLong: Until you remove them, or either account is deleted

visits.howLong: One week: older ones are erased the next time you enter a room, and all of them with the account

limits.what: Abuse counters (fingerprints, no IP address or e-mail)

links.howLong: Valid 24 hours; erased when used, when a new link is made, or with the account

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.lead: The site uses only the cookies it needs to work: no analytics, advertising or tracking cookies, and none from third parties. That is why it shows no cookie banner.

session.name: authjs.session-token
session.purpose: Keeping you signed in to your account
session.duration: 30 days, or until you sign out

signIn.name: authjs.csrf-token, authjs.callback-url
signIn.purpose: Protecting sign-in and bringing you back to the right page

google.name: authjs.state, authjs.pkce.code_verifier, authjs.nonce
google.duration: 15 minutes, or until the browser closes

locale.name: NEXT_LOCALE
locale.duration: until the browser closes; one year if set just before a Google sign-in

mute.name: sh:muted:CODE (local storage)
mute.purpose: The players you muted in a room

cookies.prefix: On the live site, the sign-in cookies' names start with __Secure- or __Host-.
cookies.fonts: The fonts are served by the site itself: your browser does not contact Google Fonts.
cookies.worker: The site installs a small program in your browser (a service worker) that caches the site's files (scripts, styles and an offline page), never a page or any personal data.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.lead: You can ask to access your data, to have it corrected or erased, to receive it in a common format (portability), to object to its use or to have its use restricted.
rights.profile: On your <link>profile</link> you see your history and your blocks, change your name (once every 30 days) and can delete your account yourself.
rights.deletion: Deleting your account erases the account, the link with Google, your blocks (and those aimed at you), your suspensions and the list of rooms visited. In other players' history you become "Deleted player". Reports (with their copy of the chat) and the moderation record keep the name you had at the time.
rights.ask: For anything else, write to <mail>{email}</mail> from your account's address, with your player name.
rights.cnil: If you think your rights are not respected, you can complain to the CNIL, the French data protection authority: <link>cnil.fr/fr/plaintes</link>.

age.title: Minimum age
age.text: The site is for people aged 15 and over. Creating an account requires confirming you are 15 or older. If you are under 15, do not use the site, even as a guest.

changes.title: Changes
changes.text: If what the site keeps changes, we update this page and its date.
